name: Composer
description: A box for writing a message or a comment, with Markdown formatting, mentions, attached files and a send button.

props.name: value
props.description: The text, when controlled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting text, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called on every edit, including formatting and mentions.

props.name: files
props.description: Attached files, when controlled. Each is { id, name, size, type?, src?, file? }: size in bytes, src a thumbnail address for images, file the picked File when it came from the user.

props.name: defaultFiles
props.description: The starting files, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onFilesChange
props.description: Called when files are attached, dropped or removed.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint shown while the text is empty.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called on send. If it returns a promise, the send button shows a spinner until it settles; the text and files clear when it resolves and stay when it rejects.

props.name: submitOn
props.description: Enter sends and Shift+Enter starts a line, or Command/Ctrl+Enter sends and Enter starts a line. Nothing is sent while an input method is composing.

props.name: isPending
props.description: Controls the sending state yourself. Overrides the state that a returned promise drives.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the text, the tools and sending, and dims the box to 50%.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Most characters allowed. Shows a count beside the send button that turns yuzu near the limit and camellia at it.

props.name: minRows
props.description: Rows of text shown when empty.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Rows the text grows to before it scrolls.

props.name: tools
props.description: Toolbar buttons, in this order. Bold, italic and link wrap the selection in Markdown (also Command/Ctrl+B, I and K). Without attach, files cannot be dropped either.

props.name: mentions
props.type: { id: string; name: string; avatar?: string }[]
props.description: People who can be mentioned. Typing @ and letters opens a list of matches above the box; Up and Down move, Enter or Tab inserts "@Name ", Escape closes. Without it the mention tool is hidden.

props.name: accept
props.description: File types allowed, as MIME types (image/*) or extensions (.pdf). Applies to the picker and to dropped files.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Most files attached at once. Extra files are ignored and the attach tool is disabled at the limit.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the text area.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the box. Other props are spread onto it.
